title: Vector Prep Config
description: Schema for a layer-specific configuration file used by vector_prep and orchestrate. Defines metadata, core processing parameters, and optional step-specific settings.

pathString.description: File path string. Supports environment variable expansion (for example ${VAR} and $VAR).

metadata.description: Descriptive metadata used by orchestrate and reporting workflows.

layer_id.description: Stable layer identifier. Kebab-case is recommended.

source_url.description: Canonical source URL for the dataset.

source_category.description: Source category used for output routing (for example usgov, state, custom).

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot/version identifier for the source ingest. Typically YYYY-MM-DD or latest.

special_notes.description: Optional operator notes about data caveats, assumptions, or preparation details.

data_prep_operator.description: Optional operator name or handle for provenance.

row_id_source.description: Source field name used to derive deterministic rs_reports_rowid UUID5 values.

row_name_source.description: Python format string used to build rs_reports_rowname (for example: {HMA_NAME} ({HMA_ID})).

name_uniqueness.description: How duplicate generated row names are handled.

parameters.description: Processing parameters for vector_prep/orchestrate. All path values support environment variable expansion (e.g. ${HOME}/data/input.gpkg).

input.description: Absolute path to the input vector dataset (shapefile, GeoPackage, etc.). Equivalent to --input on the command line. Supports environment variable expansion.

output.description: Absolute path to write the cleaned output GeoPackage. Equivalent to --output on the command line. Supports environment variable expansion.

garbage.description: Absolute path to write a GeoPackage of dropped/changed features. Must be a .gpkg file. Equivalent to --garbage on the command line. Supports environment variable expansion.

layer.description: Layer name for GeoPackage inputs. Defaults to the first layer if omitted. Equivalent to --layer on the command line.

filter.description: SQL WHERE clause used to pre-filter features when reading the input dataset (e.g. "state_code = 'CA'"). Only matching features are loaded and processed; non-matching features are silently skipped. Equivalent to --filter on the command line.

tolerance.description: Simplification tolerance in metres (0 = skip simplification). Equivalent to --tolerance on the command line.

epsg.description: EPSG code for the Cartesian CRS used during processing (e.g. reprojection, area/length checks). Defaults to 5070 (NAD83 / Conus Albers). Equivalent to --epsg on the command line.

min_size.description: Minimum area (m²) for polygons or minimum length (m) for lines. Features below this threshold are flagged; use min_size_drop to also remove them. Equivalent to --min_size on the command line.

min_size_drop.description: If true, features below the min_size threshold are dropped from the output. If false (default), they are counted and reported but kept. Equivalent to --min_size_drop on the command line.

skip_geometry_dedup.description: If true, geometry-only duplicate dropping is skipped (check J). Full duplicate rows (geometry + attributes, check K) are still dropped. Equivalent to --skip_geometry_dedup on the command line.

chunk_size.description: Number of features to process per chunk. Larger values use more memory but may be faster. Defaults to 10000. Equivalent to --chunk_size on the command line.

verbose.description: Enable extra logging output. Equivalent to --verbose on the command line.

log_file.description: Path to a log file. When provided, logging output is written to this file instead of the default location beside the output. Equivalent to --log_file on the command line. Supports environment variable expansion.

layer_definitions.description: Relative or absolute path to the layer_definitions.json file for this layer. Required when field_map is specified. Supports environment variable expansion.

layer_id.description: Layer identifier inside layer_definitions.json to use when validating field_map. Required when layer_definitions contains multiple layers unless selected interactively.

field_map.description: Mapping from source field names to output field names. Only the fields listed here are included in the output; all other source fields are dropped.

additionalProperties.description: Output field name for this source field.

dissolve_exclude_columns.description: Optional list of source columns to exclude from dissolve grouping keys (for example OBJECTID, GlobalID). Case-insensitive.

steps.description: Optional ordered subset of orchestrator steps to enable for this layer. Steps run in canonical orchestrator order.

orchestrate_report.description: Optional path for consolidated orchestrate markdown report. Defaults to dist output folder with suffix _orchestrate_report.md.

enrich.description: Deprecated alias for add_unique_id_and_name. Prefer add_unique_id_and_name for new configs.
